prompt: Starting from `heap_init()` on the 256-byte arena, trace this sequence. Give each result as an offset into the arena, or NULL.
explain: 10 rounds to 16, so `b` starts at 16 and runs to 56; `c` takes 56..64. Freeing `a` then `b` merges them into one free block 0..56, so the 50-byte request (rounded to 56) fits exactly at 0. The only other free block is 64..256, 192 bytes, too small for 200, so `e` is NULL.
